def answer_query(image, query):
    # Initialize the ImagePatch object
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)

    # Split the query into individual words
    query_words = query.split()

    # Find patches that match each word in the query
    patches = [image_patch.find(word) for word in query_words]

    # Filter out empty patches
    patches = [patch for patch in patches if patch]

    # If no patches were found, return a message indicating so
    if not patches:
        return "No patches found matching the query."

    # Sort patches by the distance to the center of the image
    patches.sort(key=lambda patch: distance(patch, image_patch))

    # Get the best text match for each word in the query
    matches = [patch[0].best_text_match(query_words) for patch in patches]

    # If all matches are the same, return that match
    if len(set(matches)) == 1:
        return matches[0]

    # If there are multiple matches, return a message indicating so
    return "Multiple matches found. Please refine your query."
